messages:
Maria Chen: quick heads-up — PR #33021 is blocked by flaky CI, failing intermittently on integration shard 12. holding merge until we understand cause :eyes:
Samir Patel: saw this earlier, looks like a timeout in the kv-eviction test, but only on linux-stable pool. not reproduced locally yet.
buildkite-bot: Build 452 • PR 33021 • failed • https://buildkite.example/teams/redwood/pipelines/ci/builds/452 — failing job: integ-shard-12 (timeout)
Kevin Liu: can someone paste the failing test snippet?
Maria Chen: paste below:
```
FAILED tests/integration/test_kv_eviction.py::test_kv_eviction_with_randomized_load
E   TimeoutError: operation exceeded 120s
E   Query trace: shard=12 host=gpu-12-04
```
Samir Patel: thanks — that test touches the fixture that spins up a local minibatch runner. I have a hunch it's flakey when memory pressure + concurrent requests spike.
Jenny Ortiz: @Samir can you try a targeted rerun on shard 12 so we know if it's transient? if green we can consider approving and landing.
Samir Patel: on it. running: `/rerun ci pr=33021 shard=12 timeout=30m`
buildkite-bot: Triggered rerun 453 for PR 33021 (shard 12) — queued
Oliver Park: FYI, I noticed a recent change in #32890 to the eviction thresholds; could be related. if Samir sees consistent failures we should bisect that change.
Samir Patel: rerun finished — still failing, same timeout. I'll try reproducing locally with stress flags. assigning to myself for triage.
Maria Chen: ok — since rerun failed, hold off on approvals. @Kevin can you delay the merge window flag until Samir updates? we don't want to land and rollback. :merge:
Kevin Liu: ack — I'll keep it blocked. If Samir identifies transient root cause, we can try a snapshot update or a fix branch + quick canary.
Jenny Ortiz: small ask — if we do need a snapshot update, include the failing output and the exact Buildkite link in the PR so reviewers can fast-track.
Samir Patel: plan: reproduce locally with `--stress --concurrency=8`, if repro I'll bisect against #32890 and open a hotfix. ETA ~2hrs. ping me for approvals once I have a green or a fix.
Maria Chen: thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround. cc @buildkite-bot (for logs) and @Oliver on the bisect. :thumbsup:
